The property

The Garden Residence

A private, self-contained two-bedroom retreat within the estate.

Overview

A private self-contained garden residence

Set apart from the main house within the grounds of Carlton Ridge, the garden residence is a fully self-contained two-bedroom retreat with its own private front door, private parking area, open-plan living space, full kitchen and shared patio. The kitchen is properly equipped for extended stays, with a fridge freezer, oven, cooking hob, microwave and washing machine, so guests staying here can live entirely independently of the main house if they choose.

Finished to the same standard as the main villa and fully air-conditioned throughout, it offers a genuine home-within-a-home, multigenerational escape — ideal for grandparents seeking their own space, older children wanting a little independence, or a family with small children who prefer some space away from the main house.

Inside

Two bedrooms, each with its own view

Garden Residence Suite One

A bright, en-suite bedroom fitted with a full-size bed (UK king equivalent), a walk-in wardrobe and an in-room safe for valuables. Ceiling fans and air conditioning keep the room cool through the day, and the adjoining living area — with its own full kitchen and access out to the shared patio — means guests staying here can come and go entirely on their own schedule, right down to their own front door and parking.

Garden Residence Suite Two

The second bedroom in the garden residence shares the same easy, independent footprint — en suite, air-conditioned, and furnished with a full-size bed (UK king equivalent), walk-in wardrobe and in-room safe. Tucked among Carlton Ridge’s manicured gardens and flowering trees, it’s a quiet, restful spot just off the garden residence’s shared living space, with the patio, pool, gazebo and wet bar only a short stroll away.

At a glance

Garden Residence features

  • Private front door and dedicated parking area, separate from the main house
  • Two en-suite bedrooms, both air-conditioned
  • Full-size beds (UK king equivalent) in each room
  • Walk-in wardrobe and safe in each bedroom
  • Full kitchen with fridge freezer, oven, cooking hob, microwave and washing machine
  • Private open-plan living area
  • Patio, accessed via the common living room
  • Direct access to the gardens, pool deck, gazebo and wet bar
  • Finished to match the main house's standard throughout
